prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 3:2 aviation blog cover, 1536 by 1024. Sophisticated flat painted graphic design, muted slate blue, warm cream and soft green, controlled shading, uncluttered composition. Keep wings, tail and nose comfortably within frame. No people, text, numbers, logos, registration markings, arrows, airflow ribbons, diagrams, instruments, warning symbols or watermarks. No dramatic steep bank, stall, spin or imminent collision. This is a conceptual aviation cover, not a flight procedure diagram.
